subject: english
label: 中学英作文
blurb: 中学で習う文法で言える日常の文を、日本語から英文にして打つ
audience: 中学生、中学英語をやり直す人

genres.wj-relative: 関係代名詞・分詞・間接疑問

words.answer: I am a student.
accept: I'm a student.
words.q: 私は学生です。（be動詞を使って）
words.explain: 主語 I には am。数えられる名詞が1つなら冠詞 a を忘れない。I am student は誤り
words.say: I am a student.

words.answer: She is from Kyoto.
accept: She's from Kyoto.
She comes from Kyoto.
words.q: 彼女は京都出身です。（from を使って）
words.explain: 「〜出身」は be from。She is Kyoto や She from Kyoto のように be動詞や from を落とさない
words.say: She is from Kyoto.

words.answer: Are you a teacher?
words.q: あなたは先生ですか。（be動詞を使って）
words.explain: be動詞の疑問文は be動詞を文頭に。Do you a teacher? は誤り。文末は ?
words.say: Are you a teacher?

words.answer: I like dogs.
words.q: 私は犬が好きです。（like を使って）
words.explain: 一般動詞の文に be動詞は不要（I am like は誤り）。「犬というもの」は複数形 dogs
words.say: I like dogs.

words.answer: He plays soccer every day.
accept: Every day he plays soccer.
words.q: 彼は毎日サッカーをします。（play を使って）
words.explain: 主語が三人称単数で現在なら動詞に s。every day は2語で、everyday（形容詞）と区別
words.say: He plays soccer every day.

words.answer: Emi does not like math.
accept: Emi doesn't like math.
words.q: エミは数学が好きではありません。
words.explain: 三人称単数の否定は does not＋原形。does not likes と s を二重にしない
words.say: Emi does not like math.

words.answer: Does Ken speak English?
words.q: ケンは英語を話しますか。（Does で始めて）
words.explain: Does＋主語＋原形。Does Ken speaks は誤り。Is Ken speak のように be動詞を使わない
words.say: Does Ken speak English?

words.answer: This is not my bag.
accept: This isn't my bag.
This bag is not mine.
This bag isn't mine.
words.q: これは私のかばんではありません。
words.explain: be動詞の否定は is の後ろに not。my の後ろには必ず名詞（my bag）。my だけでは終われない
words.say: This is not my bag.

words.answer: My father usually gets up at six.
accept: My father usually gets up at six o'clock.
words.q: 私の父はふつう6時に起きます。（usually, get up を使って）
words.explain: usually は一般動詞の前。主語が my father なので gets。時刻は at six
words.say: My father usually gets up at six.

words.answer: Emi has two cats and a dog.
accept: Emi has two cats and one dog.
words.q: エミは猫を2匹と犬を1匹飼っています。（have を使って）
words.explain: have の三単現は haves ではなく has。「飼っている」は have でよい。two cats は複数形
words.say: Emi has two cats and a dog.

words.answer: What is this?
accept: What's this?
words.q: これは何ですか。（What で始めて）
words.explain: 疑問詞＋be動詞＋主語。答えは It is a … で返す。This is what? とはしない
words.say: What is this?

words.answer: Where do you live?
words.q: あなたはどこに住んでいますか。
words.explain: Where＋do＋主語＋原形。live は「住んでいる」でも進行形にしない。Where are you live は誤り
words.say: Where do you live?

words.answer: Please open the window.
accept: Open the window, please.
words.q: 窓を開けてください。（please を使って）
words.explain: 命令文は動詞の原形で始める。please を文末に置くならコンマを付ける
words.say: Please open the window.

words.answer: Don't run here.
accept: Do not run here.
words.q: ここで走ってはいけません。（Don't を使って）
words.explain: 否定の命令文は Don't＋原形。Not run や You don't run では命令にならない
words.say: Don't run here.

words.answer: What time is it now?
words.q: 今、何時ですか。（What time で始めて）
words.explain: 時刻の主語は it。What time is it now? の now は文末。What time is now? は主語がなく誤り
words.say: What time is it now?

words.answer: How many brothers do you have?
words.q: あなたには兄弟が何人いますか。（How many で始めて）
words.explain: How many＋複数名詞 を文頭にまとめ、その後ろに do you have。brother に s を忘れない
words.say: How many brothers do you have?

words.answer: Let's play tennis after school.
words.q: 放課後、テニスをしましょう。（Let's を使って）
words.explain: Let's＋原形。「放課後」は after school で the は付けない。スポーツ名にも the は不要
words.say: Let's play tennis after school.

words.answer: Whose bike is this?
accept: Whose bicycle is this?
words.q: これはだれの自転車ですか。（Whose で始めて）
words.explain: Whose＋名詞 をひとかたまりで文頭に。Who's（who is）と混同しない
words.say: Whose bike is this?

words.answer: Why were you absent yesterday?
words.ja: 疑問詞 why＋be動詞の過去
words.q: あなたはなぜ昨日欠席したのですか。（absent を使って）
words.explain: absent は形容詞なので be動詞を使う。Why did you absent は誤り。過去なので were
words.say: Why were you absent yesterday?

words.answer: How often do you go to the library?
words.q: あなたはどのくらいの頻度で図書館へ行きますか。
words.explain: 頻度は How often、期間は How long、回数は How many times と使い分ける
words.say: How often do you go to the library?

words.answer: I am reading a book now.
accept: I'm reading a book now.
words.q: 私は今、本を読んでいます。（now を使って）
words.explain: be動詞＋動詞ing。I reading や I am read は誤り。now は文末
words.say: I am reading a book now.

words.answer: She is not sleeping.
accept: She isn't sleeping.
She's not sleeping.
words.q: 彼女は眠っていません。（進行形で）
words.explain: 進行形の否定は be動詞の後ろに not。She does not sleeping のように do を使わない
words.say: She is not sleeping.

words.answer: What are you doing?
words.q: あなたは何をしているのですか。
words.explain: What＋be動詞＋主語＋doing。「している」は do の進行形 doing。What do you doing は誤り
words.say: What are you doing?

words.answer: I went to Kyoto last year.
accept: Last year I went to Kyoto.
words.q: 私は去年、京都へ行きました。（go を使って）
words.explain: go の過去形は went。last year に in は付けない（in last year は誤り）
words.say: I went to Kyoto last year.

words.answer: Did you watch TV last night?
accept: Did you watch television last night?
words.q: あなたは昨夜テレビを見ましたか。
words.explain: Did＋主語＋原形。Did you watched は誤り。「テレビを見る」は watch TV で see は使わない
words.say: Did you watch TV last night?

words.answer: He did not eat breakfast this morning.
accept: He didn't eat breakfast this morning.
He did not have breakfast this morning.
He didn't have breakfast this morning.
words.q: 彼は今朝、朝食を食べませんでした。
words.explain: did not＋原形。breakfast に a や the は付けない。this morning に in は不要
words.say: He did not eat breakfast this morning.

words.answer: I was watching TV then.
words.q: 私はそのときテレビを見ていました。（then を使って）
words.explain: 過去進行形は was/were＋動詞ing。「そのとき」then は文末。I watched では「見た」になる
words.say: I was watching TV then.

words.answer: She was very tired yesterday.
accept: Yesterday she was very tired.
words.q: 彼女は昨日とても疲れていました。
words.explain: 「疲れている」は形容詞 tired なので be動詞の過去 was。She tired は誤り
words.say: She was very tired yesterday.

words.answer: Were you studying at nine last night?
accept: Were you studying at nine o'clock last night?
words.q: あなたは昨夜9時に勉強していましたか。
words.explain: 過去進行形の疑問文は Were＋主語＋動詞ing。Did you studying は誤り。時刻→時の順
words.say: Were you studying at nine last night?

words.answer: What were they doing in the park?
words.q: 彼らは公園で何をしていましたか。
words.explain: What＋were＋主語＋doing＋場所。主語 they には were。in the park の the を落とさない
words.say: What were they doing in the park?

words.answer: I will call you tomorrow.
accept: I'll call you tomorrow.
words.q: 私は明日あなたに電話します。（will を使って）
words.explain: will＋原形。call you で「あなたに電話する」、to は不要（call to you は誤り）
words.say: I will call you tomorrow.

words.answer: It will be sunny tomorrow.
accept: It'll be sunny tomorrow.
It is going to be sunny tomorrow.
It's going to be sunny tomorrow.
words.q: 明日は晴れるでしょう。（It で始めて）
words.explain: 天気の主語は it。will の後ろは原形 be。It will sunny のように be を落とすのが定番の誤り
words.say: It will be sunny tomorrow.

words.answer: I can swim well.
words.q: 私は上手に泳ぐことができます。（can を使って）
words.explain: can＋原形。「上手に」は副詞 well で文末。good は形容詞なので swim good は誤り
words.say: I can swim well.

words.answer: Can you play the guitar?
words.q: あなたはギターを弾けますか。（Can で始めて）
words.explain: Can＋主語＋原形。Do you can は誤り。楽器には the（play the guitar）
words.say: Can you play the guitar?

words.answer: You must do your homework now.
words.q: あなたは今、宿題をしなければなりません。（must を使って）
words.explain: must＋原形。「宿題をする」は do one's homework。must to do は誤り
words.say: You must do your homework now.

words.answer: You should see a doctor.
accept: You should go to the doctor.
words.q: あなたは医者に診てもらうべきです。（should を使って）
words.explain: 「医者に診てもらう」は see a doctor。should の後ろは原形。冠詞 a を忘れない
words.say: You should see a doctor.

words.answer: May I use your pen?
words.q: あなたのペンを使ってもいいですか。（May で始めて）
words.explain: May I＋原形で許可を求める。use は「使う」で to は不要。your の後ろに名詞 pen
words.say: May I use your pen?

words.answer: She is going to visit Tokyo next week.
accept: She's going to visit Tokyo next week.
Next week she is going to visit Tokyo.
words.q: 彼女は来週、東京を訪れる予定です。（be going to を使って）
words.explain: be going to＋原形。visit は他動詞で to は不要（visit to Tokyo は誤り）。next week に in は付けない
words.say: She is going to visit Tokyo next week.

words.answer: I do not have to go to school today.
accept: I don't have to go to school today.
words.q: 私は今日、学校へ行く必要はありません。（have to を使って）
words.explain: don't have to は「〜しなくてよい」。must not だと「してはいけない」で意味が変わる
words.say: I do not have to go to school today.

words.answer: Will you help me with my homework?
accept: Will you help me do my homework?
words.q: 私の宿題を手伝ってくれませんか。（Will で始めて）
words.explain: 「人の〜を手伝う」は help＋人＋with＋物。help my homework は誤り（人が目的語）
words.say: Will you help me with my homework?

words.answer: I want to be a teacher.
accept: I want to become a teacher.
words.q: 私は先生になりたいです。（want を使って）
words.explain: want to＋原形。「〜になる」は be。冠詞 a を忘れない。I want be は誤り
words.say: I want to be a teacher.

words.answer: I like to play soccer.
words.q: 私はサッカーをするのが好きです。（to を使って）
words.explain: like to＋原形。like playing でも同じ意味。スポーツ名に the は付けない
words.say: I like to play soccer.

words.answer: I am happy to see you.
accept: I'm happy to see you.
I am glad to see you.
I'm glad to see you.
words.q: 私はあなたに会えてうれしいです。
words.explain: 形容詞＋to＋原形で「〜してうれしい」。「会う」は see でよく、meet は初対面のとき
words.say: I am happy to see you.

words.answer: Thank you for coming today.
words.q: 今日は来てくれてありがとう。（for を使って）
words.explain: 前置詞 for の後ろは動名詞 coming。Thank you for come／to come は誤り
words.say: Thank you for coming today.

words.answer: I went to the park to play soccer.
words.ja: 不定詞（副詞的用法・目的）
words.q: 私はサッカーをするために公園へ行きました。
words.explain: 「〜するために」は to＋原形を文末に。for playing より to play が自然
words.say: I went to the park to play soccer.

words.answer: I have many things to do today.
accept: I have a lot of things to do today.
I have lots of things to do today.
words.q: 私は今日、することがたくさんあります。（things を使って）
words.explain: things to do で「すべきこと」。不定詞は名詞の後ろから修飾。to do things は語順が逆
words.say: I have many things to do today.

words.answer: Playing the piano is fun.
words.q: ピアノを弾くことは楽しいです。（-ing で始めて）
words.explain: 動名詞のかたまりが主語で単数扱い。動詞は is。fun は名詞なので a は付けない
words.say: Playing the piano is fun.

words.answer: It is important to study English.
accept: It's important to study English.
words.q: 英語を勉強することは大切です。（It で始めて）
words.explain: 形式主語 It＋is＋形容詞＋to＋原形。English study のように語順を日本語のままにしない
words.say: It is important to study English.

words.answer: This tea is too hot to drink.
words.q: このお茶は熱すぎて飲めません。（too を使って）
words.explain: too＋形容詞＋to＋原形で「〜すぎて…できない」。can't や not は入れない。文末に it を置かない
words.say: This tea is too hot to drink.

words.answer: I want you to help me.
words.q: 私はあなたに手伝ってほしいです。（want を使って）
words.explain: want＋人＋to＋原形で「人に〜してほしい」。I want to help me では自分が手伝う意味になる
words.say: I want you to help me.

words.answer: I am taller than my father.
accept: I'm taller than my father.
words.q: 私は父より背が高いです。（than を使って）
words.explain: tall＋er＋than。「背が高い」は tall 1語で high は使わない。more taller は誤り
words.say: I am taller than my father.

words.answer: This question is easier than that one.
accept: This question is easier than that question.
words.q: この問題はあの問題より簡単です。（than を使って）
words.explain: easy の比較級は y を i に変えて easier。that one の one は question の代わり
words.say: This question is easier than that one.

words.answer: Ken is the tallest in our class.
accept: Ken is the tallest student in our class.
Ken is the tallest boy in our class.
words.q: ケンは私たちのクラスでいちばん背が高いです。
words.explain: 最上級には the を付ける。「クラスで」は範囲なので in。of our class は誤り
words.say: Ken is the tallest in our class.

words.answer: I like summer better than winter.
accept: I like summer more than winter.
words.q: 私は冬より夏の方が好きです。（than を使って）
words.explain: like A better than B。好きな方 A を先に言う。日本語の「冬より」の順につられない
words.say: I like summer better than winter.

words.answer: This is the most famous temple in Kyoto.
words.q: これは京都でいちばん有名な寺です。
words.explain: 長い形容詞は the most＋原級。famousest は誤り。the most famous temple の順
words.say: This is the most famous temple in Kyoto.

words.answer: Math is the most difficult subject for me.
accept: Math is the hardest subject for me.
words.q: 数学は私にとっていちばん難しい教科です。
words.explain: 「私にとって」は for me で文末。教科名 math は無冠詞・大文字にしない
words.say: Math is the most difficult subject for me.

words.answer: He can run as fast as Ken.
words.q: 彼はケンと同じくらい速く走ることができます。
words.explain: as＋原級＋as。副詞 fast はそのまま（faster にしない）。as fast as は run の後ろ
words.say: He can run as fast as Ken.

words.answer: Which do you like better, tea or coffee?
words.q: 紅茶とコーヒーでは、どちらの方が好きですか。
words.explain: Which do you like better, A or B? の形。2つから選ぶので better。tea の前に a は不要
words.say: Which do you like better, tea or coffee?

words.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
accept: English is spoken in a lot of countries.
words.q: 英語は多くの国で話されています。
words.explain: be動詞＋過去分詞。speak の過去分詞は spoken（spoke ではない）。country の複数は countries
words.say: English is spoken in many countries.

words.answer: This picture was painted by Emi.
words.q: この絵はエミによって描かれました。（paint を使って）
words.explain: 過去の受け身は was/were＋過去分詞。行為者は by。was painted で1セット
words.say: This picture was painted by Emi.

words.answer: This temple was built two hundred years ago.
words.ja: 受け身（過去・by なし）
words.q: この寺は200年前に建てられました。
words.explain: build の過去分詞は built。「〜年前」は数＋years ago。ago の前に before は付けない
words.say: This temple was built two hundred years ago.

words.answer: Is this car made in Japan?
accept: Was this car made in Japan?
words.q: この車は日本で作られたものですか。（made を使って）
words.explain: 受け身の疑問文は be動詞を文頭に。Does this car made は誤り。「日本製」は made in Japan
words.say: Is this car made in Japan?

words.answer: I was surprised at the news.
accept: I was surprised by the news.
words.q: 私はその知らせに驚きました。（surprised を使って）
words.explain: 「驚く」は受け身 be surprised at。I surprised だと「驚かせた」になる
words.say: I was surprised at the news.

words.answer: The room was not cleaned yesterday.
accept: The room wasn't cleaned yesterday.
Yesterday the room was not cleaned.
words.q: その部屋は昨日そうじされませんでした。
words.explain: 受け身の否定は be動詞の後ろに not。did not cleaned のように did を使わない
words.say: The room was not cleaned yesterday.

words.answer: I have been to Tokyo three times.
accept: I've been to Tokyo three times.
words.q: 私は東京に3回行ったことがあります。（been を使って）
words.explain: 「行ったことがある」は have been to。回数 three times は文末。have gone to は「行ってしまった」
words.say: I have been to Tokyo three times.

words.answer: I have already finished my homework.
accept: I've already finished my homework.
I have finished my homework already.
I've finished my homework already.
words.q: 私はもう宿題を終えました。（already を使って）
words.explain: already は have と過去分詞の間が基本。finish は規則動詞で finished
words.say: I have already finished my homework.

words.answer: Have you ever eaten sushi?
accept: Have you ever had sushi?
words.q: あなたは今までにすしを食べたことがありますか。
words.explain: Have＋主語＋ever＋過去分詞。eat の過去分詞は eaten（ate ではない）
words.say: Have you ever eaten sushi?

words.answer: She has not come yet.
accept: She hasn't come yet.
words.q: 彼女はまだ来ていません。（yet を使って）
words.explain: 主語が三人称単数なら has not。come の過去分詞は come（came ではない）。yet は文末
words.say: She has not come yet.

words.answer: I have lived in Tokyo for ten years.
accept: I've lived in Tokyo for ten years.
I have been living in Tokyo for ten years.
I've been living in Tokyo for ten years.
words.q: 私は東京に10年間住んでいます。
words.explain: 「ずっと住んでいる」は現在完了。期間は for、起点は since。I live … for ten years は誤り
words.say: I have lived in Tokyo for ten years.

words.answer: How long have you known him?
words.ja: 現在完了の疑問文（期間）
words.q: あなたはどのくらいの間、彼を知っていますか。
words.explain: How long＋have＋主語＋過去分詞。know の過去分詞は known。knowing と進行形にはしない
words.say: How long have you known him?

words.answer: He has just left home.
accept: He's just left home.
words.q: 彼はちょうど家を出たところです。（just を使って）
words.explain: just は has と過去分詞の間。leave の過去分詞は left。「家を出る」は leave home で to や the は不要
words.say: He has just left home.

words.answer: I have never seen such a big dog.
accept: I've never seen such a big dog.
words.q: 私はこんなに大きな犬を見たことがありません。（such を使って）
words.explain: never は have と seen の間。such の後ろは a＋形容詞＋名詞の順（a such big dog は誤り）
words.say: I have never seen such a big dog.

words.answer: It has been raining since this morning.
accept: It's been raining since this morning.
It has rained since this morning.
words.q: 今朝からずっと雨が降っています。（It で始めて）
words.explain: 動作の継続は have been＋動詞ing。「今朝から」は since this morning。from は使わない
words.say: It has been raining since this morning.

words.answer: My father gave me a watch.
accept: My father gave a watch to me.
words.q: 父は私に腕時計をくれました。（give を使って）
words.explain: give＋人＋物 の順。「くれた」も gave でよい。腕時計は watch、clock は置き時計
words.say: My father gave me a watch.

words.answer: Please show me your notebook.
accept: Show me your notebook, please.
Please show your notebook to me.
words.q: あなたのノートを私に見せてください。
words.explain: show＋人＋物。命令文なので動詞の原形から。your notebook の your を落とさない
words.say: Please show me your notebook.

words.answer: The news made me happy.
words.q: その知らせは私を幸せにしました。（make を使って）
words.explain: make＋人＋形容詞で「人を〜にする」。made me happily と副詞にしない
words.say: The news made me happy.

words.answer: We call him Ken.
words.q: 私たちは彼をケンと呼びます。（call を使って）
words.explain: call＋人＋呼び名。call him as Ken のように as は入れない
words.say: We call him Ken.

words.answer: There is a park near my house.
accept: There's a park near my house.
words.q: 私の家の近くに公園があります。（There で始めて）
words.explain: There is＋単数名詞＋場所。「近くに」は near で、near to や near of は不要
words.say: There is a park near my house.

words.answer: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
words.q: 私は疲れていたので、早く寝ました。（so を使って）
words.explain: 原因, so 結果 の順。because と逆向き。「寝る」は go to bed で the は付けない
words.say: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

words.answer: If it is sunny tomorrow, let's go to the park.
accept: If it's sunny tomorrow, let's go to the park.
words.q: もし明日晴れたら、公園へ行きましょう。（If で始めて）
words.explain: 条件の if 節は未来でも現在形（if it will be は誤り）。天気の主語は it
words.say: If it is sunny tomorrow, let's go to the park.

words.answer: When I got home, my mother was cooking dinner.
accept: When I came home, my mother was cooking dinner.
words.ja: 接続詞 when＋過去進行形
words.q: 私が家に帰ったとき、母は夕食を作っていました。（When で始めて、cook を使って）
words.explain: when 節は過去形、主節は「〜していた」で過去進行形。「家に帰る」は get home で to は不要
words.say: When I got home, my mother was cooking dinner.

words.answer: Because I was sick, I could not go to school.
accept: Because I was sick, I couldn't go to school.
words.q: 私は病気だったので、学校へ行けませんでした。（Because で始めて）
words.explain: Because 節を文頭に置くときはコンマで区切り、結果の文を続ける。can の過去は could
words.say: Because I was sick, I could not go to school.

words.answer: I have a friend who lives in Kyoto.
words.q: 私には京都に住んでいる友達がいます。（who を使って）
words.explain: 人を修飾するときは who。先行詞 a friend は単数なので lives。名詞の後ろから修飾する
words.say: I have a friend who lives in Kyoto.

words.answer: This is the book that I bought yesterday.
words.ja: 関係代名詞 that（目的格）
words.q: これは私が昨日買った本です。（that を使って）
words.explain: the book that＋主語＋動詞。bought の後ろに it を置かない（関係代名詞が目的語の役）
words.say: This is the book that I bought yesterday.

words.answer: The girl singing over there is Emi.
words.q: 向こうで歌っている女の子はエミです。（-ing を使って）
words.explain: singing over there が The girl を後ろから修飾し、文の動詞は is。長い主語でも動詞を忘れない
words.say: The girl singing over there is Emi.

words.answer: The boy playing soccer is my brother.
accept: The boy playing soccer is my younger brother.
words.q: サッカーをしている少年は私の弟です。（-ing を使って）
words.explain: 分詞に語句が続くときは名詞の後ろ（the playing soccer boy は誤り）。「弟」は brother でよい
words.say: The boy playing soccer is my brother.

words.answer: I know where he lives.
words.q: 私は彼がどこに住んでいるか知っています。
words.explain: 間接疑問は疑問詞＋主語＋動詞の肯定文の語順。where does he live のまま入れない
words.say: I know where he lives.

words.answer: Do you know what this is?
words.q: あなたはこれが何か知っていますか。
words.explain: 文全体は疑問文でも、中の what this is は肯定文の語順。what is this にしない
words.say: Do you know what this is?

words.answer: This is a picture taken by my father.
accept: This is a photo taken by my father.
words.q: これは父によって撮られた写真です。（過去分詞を使って）
words.explain: 「撮られた」は過去分詞 taken＋by。taking では「撮っている」になる
words.say: This is a picture taken by my father.

words.answer: Is this the bus that goes to the station?
words.ja: 疑問文＋関係代名詞 that
words.q: これは駅へ行くバスですか。（that を使って）
words.explain: 先行詞 the bus は三人称単数なので goes。関係詞節は先行詞の直後に置く
words.say: Is this the bus that goes to the station?

words.answer: The man who is talking with Emi is my teacher.
accept: The man who is talking to Emi is my teacher.
words.ja: 関係代名詞 who（主語を修飾）
words.q: エミと話している男性は私の先生です。（who を使って）
words.explain: The man who … Emi までが主語。そのあとに文の動詞 is。is が2つあってよい
words.say: The man who is talking with Emi is my teacher.

words.answer: I do not know why she was angry.
accept: I don't know why she was angry.
words.q: 私は彼女がなぜ怒っていたのか知りません。
words.explain: why の後ろは she was angry の肯定文の語順。why was she としない。時制は過去のまま
words.say: I do not know why she was angry.

words.answer: I wish I were a bird.
accept: I wish I was a bird.
words.ja: 仮定法 I wish＋過去形
words.q: 私が鳥だったらなあ。（wish を使って）
words.explain: 現実と違う願望は I wish＋主語＋過去形。be動詞は主語が I でも were が基本
words.say: I wish I were a bird.

words.answer: I wish I could fly.
words.q: 空を飛べたらなあ。（wish を使って）
words.explain: 「〜できたらなあ」は I wish I could＋原形。can のままにしない
words.say: I wish I could fly.

words.answer: I wish I had a brother.
words.q: 私に兄弟がいたらなあ。（wish を使って）
words.explain: 「いたらなあ」は I wish I had。「兄弟がいる」は have a brother で there is は使わない
words.say: I wish I had a brother.

words.answer: If I were you, I would go there.
accept: If I were you, I'd go there.
If I was you, I would go there.
words.ja: 仮定法 If I were you
words.q: もし私があなたなら、そこへ行くでしょう。（If で始めて）
words.explain: If＋過去形, 主語＋would＋原形。there は副詞なので go to there は誤り
words.say: If I were you, I would go there.

words.answer: I wish I could speak English well.
words.q: 英語が上手に話せたらなあ。（wish を使って）
words.explain: 願望の内容は could＋原形。「上手に」は副詞 well を文末に
words.say: I wish I could speak English well.

words.answer: I wish he were here now.
accept: I wish he was here now.
words.ja: 仮定法 I wish（三人称）
words.q: 彼が今ここにいたらなあ。（wish を使って）
words.explain: 主語が he でも仮定法では were が基本。here は副詞で in here は不要
words.say: I wish he were here now.

words.answer: If I had a lot of money, I could buy this house.
accept: If I had lots of money, I could buy this house.
words.q: お金がたくさんあれば、この家を買えるのに。（If で始めて）
words.explain: 現実には持っていないので if 節は過去形 had。主節は could＋原形。can は使わない
words.say: If I had a lot of money, I could buy this house.

words.answer: If it were sunny, we could play outside.
accept: If it was sunny, we could play outside.
words.q: もし晴れていたら、外で遊べるのに。（If で始めて）
words.explain: 今の天気と違う仮定なので If it were。outside は副詞で at や in は不要
words.say: If it were sunny, we could play outside.
